style_notes: rust cathedral register: a flat metal plateau under a sun standing straight overhead forever, the ground an ancient factory roof of riveted deck plate cut by a maze of deliberate circuit-board walls, rust dust banked against them, heat shimmer, hard white overhead light; bake NO cast shadow onto the ground; painterly vanilla-RimWorld art style, grounded believable materials, matte except bare worked metal, never cartoonish, never cute, no outlines; genuinely transparent alpha background; owner law verbatim: "Your color palette is too uniform per biome. Needs more variety." - this subject's palette anchor is FADED SAFETY-YELLOW and OXIDE-RED paint worn down to bare gunmetal at every edge, with black track rubber and pale rust dust caked in the tracks; colossal scale, bs~6, drawSize ~5; idling, boom lowered; north facing is a true rear view seen from directly behind: the back of the hull, the engine housing and both tracks, no drill tip or lens visible
prompt: RimWorld game creature sprite: the borehulk, a colossal old mining droid that is more a digging tank than a robot: a long low armoured hull on two broad caterpillar tracks, slabs of thick riveted armour plate bolted over everything, a heavy articulated boom at the front ending in a big conical drill head that is WORN DOWN TO A BLUNT STUB with chipped flutes, a wide bucket scoop slung under the boom, and a tiny dim sensor head with one dull amber lens sitting almost lost on top of the hull. It looks enormously strong, slow, harmless and not very bright. Industrial mining machine, never a war machine: no guns, no weapons, no spikes.
